"""Independent stdlib audit of a frozen pure-ELF matrix archive."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,struct,sys,re
archive=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();output=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def require(ok,msg):
 if not ok:raise AssertionError(msg)
r=json.loads((archive/'full-coverage.json').read_text())
require(r['scope_complete'] and r['source_stable'] and not r['failure'] and not r['skip'] and not r['remaining'] and not r['known_gap'],'complete zero-skip matrix')
require(len(r['successful_tests'])==51 and len(r['requirements'])==27,'original complete scope')
for item in r['requirements']:require(item['passed'] and set(item['tests'])<=set(r['successful_tests']),'requirement closure')
require(r['source_before']==r['source_after'],'source binding')
for name,digest in r['source_after'].items():require(sha(name)==digest,'source drift '+name)
pure=r['pure_elf'];require(pure['no_target_nasm'],'no fallback')
count=0;variants=set();modes=set();elf_hashes=set();executed=set()
for asm,target in pure['targets'].items():
 p=Path(asm);require(sha(p)==target['source_sha256'],'emitted source hash')
 raw=Path(target['elf_path']).read_bytes();require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==target['elf_sha256'],'ELF hash');elf_hashes.add(target['elf_sha256'])
 require(raw[:7]==b'\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01','ELF64 header')
 require(struct.unpack_from('<HH',raw,16)==(2,62),'ET_EXEC x86-64')
 ph=struct.unpack_from('<Q',raw,32)[0];size,n=struct.unpack_from('<HH',raw,54);require(size==56 and n in (1,2),'program headers')
 segments=[]
 for i in range(n):
  kind,flags,off,va,pa,fs,ms,align=struct.unpack_from('<II6Q',raw,ph+i*size)
  require(kind==1 and flags in (5,6) and fs<=ms and off+fs<=len(raw) and va==0x400000+off and align==4096,'segment bounds/WX')
  segments.append(dict(address=va,file_size=fs,memory_size=ms,flags=flags))
 require(sha(p.with_suffix('.elf-input.asm'))==target['input_sha256'],'adapter input hash')
 original=p.read_text();full=p.with_suffix('.elf-input.asm').read_text();footer='%ifidn __OUTPUT_FORMAT__,elf64'
 before,after=original.split(footer);require(full.startswith(before) and full.endswith(footer+after),'original assembly body unchanged')
 loader=Path(target['loader']).read_text();payload=loader.split('static const unsigned char raw[]={',1)[1].split('};',1)[0]
 require(bytes(map(int,payload.split(',')))==raw,'exact ELF embedded in host loader')
 obj=p.with_suffix('.obj').read_bytes();machine,sections,stamp,ptr,ns,optional,flags=struct.unpack_from('<HHIIIHH',obj)
 require(machine==0x8664 and sections==0 and optional==0,'COFF has no target code sections')
 strings=obj[ptr+18*ns:];symbols={}
 for i in range(ns):
  entry=obj[ptr+18*i:ptr+18*(i+1)];field=entry[:8]
  if field[:4]==b'\0'*4:
   at=struct.unpack_from('<I',field,4)[0];name=strings[at:].split(b'\0',1)[0].decode()
  else:name=field.rstrip(b'\0').decode()
  address,section,typ,storage,aux=struct.unpack_from('<IhHBB',entry,8)
  require(section==-1 and storage==2 and aux==0,'absolute symbols only');symbols[name]=address
 require(symbols==target['exports'],'exact native symbol addresses')
 require(all(any(s['address']<=a<s['address']+s['memory_size'] for s in segments) for a in symbols.values()),'export ranges')
 for cmd in r['commands']:
  if cmd['command'] and Path(cmd['command'][0]).name.lower()=='nasm.exe':require(str(p) not in cmd['command'],'target passed to NASM')
 variants.add(target['variant']);modes.add('release' if p.stem.endswith('release') else 'debug');count+=1
for ex in pure['executions']:
 require(ex['elf_sha256'] in elf_hashes,'execution ELF binding');executed.add(ex['elf_sha256'])
 raw=Path(ex['exe']).read_bytes();pe=struct.unpack_from('<I',raw,60)[0];opt=pe+24
 require(raw[pe:pe+4]==b'PE\0\0' and struct.unpack_from('<Q',raw,opt+24)[0]==0x10000000,'host PE base')
 require(not(struct.unpack_from('<H',raw,opt+70)[0]&0x40),'host ASLR disabled')
require(modes=={'debug','release'} and 'good' in variants and any(v.startswith('bad-') for v in variants),'both modes and actual mutants')
require(any(x['returncode']==17 for x in pure['executions']),'real mutant rejection')
result=dict(passed=True,archive=str(archive),receipt_sha256=sha(archive/'full-coverage.json'),successful_tests=len(r['successful_tests']),requirement_groups=len(r['requirements']),frozen_inputs=len(r['source_after']),native_elf_targets=count,actual_elf_executions=len(pure['executions']),executed_distinct_elfs=len(executed),variants=sorted(variants),modes=sorted(modes),checks=['source fingerprints','all original 27 groups and 51 tests','ELF headers/segments/WX','unmodified original assembly body','exact embedded ELF bytes','COFF absolute symbols only','native export address bounds','target NASM exclusion','execution receipt ELF bindings','host PE base/ASLR','actual semantic mutant rejection'])
output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))
